area_summary: Dolphin's "$16:9 Widescreen" Gecko code for GZLE01 (Data/Sys/GameSettings/GZLE01.ini lines 348-453) is a full anamorphic native-widescreen mod. Its approach is the same as our model's. It uses r2 = _SDA2_BASE_ = 0x803FFD00 (from __init_registers at 0x80003280/84; r13 = 0x803FE0E0). Two shared choke points do most of the work. (1) 3D: the 4/3 literal @17778 (0x803FA998), which only preparation() reads (lfs at 0x8017BE5C), becomes 16/9, so view->mAspect = 16/9 x 0.96 = 1.7067. That is exactly the culling plan's mode 2, so the projection, the clipper and mDoLib_project all follow. (2) 2D: the painter's 2D J2DOrthoGraph box, x -9..650 (@5162/@5163 at 0x803F7D68/6C), becomes -123..766. The painter loads it twice, at 0x8000B03C/B04C before its bl setOrtho at 0x8000B06C and at 0x8000BA00/BA10 before its bl setOrtho at 0x8000BA30. That compresses every 2D screen drawn through the current graf port about x of about 321 by 1/1.349. The factor is 1.349, not 4/3, so 2D comes out about 1.2% too narrow under Force 16:9. The same two constants also feed setUpRectangle (0x8000A6B0/B4), which compresses mDoGph_screenCaptureDraw too, as a side effect. Everything else is per screen or per element on top of that compression. HUD parts are re-anchored by -114 (left) or +114 (right) ortho units, because the left edge moved -9 to -123 (-114) and the right 650 to 766 (+116); this is done through g_meterHIO/g_meter_mapHIO data words, per-screen draw offsets and seven small code-cave routines. Full-screen 2D is handled four ways: some is widened (wipe box, fade4 frame-buffer blit, the sea chart's 'cl' strip); three screens get a NULL graf context, so J2DScreen::draw uses its own uncompressed 0..640 ortho and they are stretched to full width (game over, wind-baton mask, Opening.blo); the pause-menu dim masks are removed outright (17 NOPs on their alpha setters); and the picto box and telescope get black pillarbox bars. One 3D-to-2D projection is fixed (boomerang sight: x' = 320 + (x-320) x 4/3). Cheap and shared: the two ortho constants (or the two bl setOrtho sites) plus the one aspect literal. Expensive: the HUD re-anchoring (about 30 sites in d_meter), the menu masks and every remaining mDoLib_project consumer. The code caves at 0x800037E0 and 0x80004038..0x800040F7 sit in zeroed padding inside gTRKInterruptVectorTable in .init (0x80003534..0x80005468). They do not collide with anything our patched disc writes: CanaryTRK is 0x8040CFB0..0x80410000, and DOLPatches, the build.py hook sites and the repo's cheats pack are all disjoint. The culling plan's §9 statement that the caves are "inside the repo's CanaryTRK region" is wrong. The Gecko code can be used for A/B comparison and as a stopgap, but never together with our mode 2 (that widens twice). Scratch decode: /Users/stephenhorton/.claude/jobs/9108197d/tmp/scratch-gecko/{decode.py,decode-out.txt,refs.py,pdis.py,summary.md}.

items.assumption: 2D ortho x = -9..650 (659 units) maps onto the 640-px EFB; y -21..503 (unchanged by the Gecko).
items.effect_native: Without it every 2D element is stretched by F. With the Gecko values: 889 units over 640 px, a factor of 1.349 relative to vanilla's 659. After Dolphin's 4/3 stretch, 2D is about 1.2% narrower than true, centred at x of about 321.5 rather than 320.5.
items.anchor: centre (all 2D is compressed about the centre; per-element re-anchoring is layered on top)
items.fix: For our mode 2, use exact F about the box centre 320.5: L = 320.5 - 329.5*F, R = 320.5 + 329.5*F (F = 4/3 gives -118.83 / 759.83). Left HUD shift = -329.5*(F-1) (-109.8 at 4/3), right = +329.5*(F-1). Two options. (a) Boot-time data rewrite of @5162/@5163 (2 words, in main01_init): cheapest, but it also compresses setUpRectangle's capture-preview blit. (b) Preferred: hook_branchlink both 'bl setOrtho' at 0x8000B06C and 0x8000BA30. r4 points at the TBox2 {x0,y0,x1,y1} on the stack, so the shim rewrites x0/x1 when mode == 2, then tail-calls 0x802CDD14. setUpRectangle and the rest of the painter stay vanilla. Either way the mode must be read live, so restoring on mode 0 is free with (b); with (a) C must write -9/650 back.

open_questions: Is the place-name card meant to be left-anchored? The Gecko forces place_name.blo's root mBounds.i.x to -123, which only makes sense if the vanilla root x is 0 and the card is meant to be left-aligned. Read *(scrn+0xC) before the patch and take a screenshot on arrival at an island.
Is the rupee counter (main_parts2.blo) really at the right of the screen? The Gecko shifts it +114, along with the swim timer and the small-key counter. Confirm with a screenshot.
Is the sea chart's 'cl' pane a class whose virtual resize leaves r3 = the J2DPane* (cave B relies on that)? If it is a J2DWindow or J2DTextBox override, the Gecko's stfs lands elsewhere.

What triggers mDoGph_screenCapture/mCaptureStep (the 152x104 capture at 320,180)? If it is player-visible, the @5162/@5163 data rewrite would compress its preview, which argues for hooking the two bl setOrtho sites (0x8000B06C, 0x8000BA30) instead.

Do the HUD shifts the Gecko applies only at init (hearts, magic, compass) survive every later re-layout? dMeter_compassDirClose and dMeter_compassValueInit are unpatched, and menuPlusMove case 4 loses its +0x52 under the x->y swap. A live run with the Gecko code should show whether these glitch.
Should our native mode remove the pause-menu dim masks as the Gecko does, or widen them (preferred; about 7 panes by tag)? This is a product decision.

Exact factor: the Gecko's ortho is 1.349x (left edge -123, right 766, shifts ±114) where Force 16:9 needs 4/3 (edges -118.8 and 759.8, shifts ±109.8). Under Dolphin Auto, the heuristic's ortho test also accepts the Gecko's 889/524 box as anamorphic. Confirm that our exact-F box still reads as anamorphic under Auto, and keep the menus from snapping back to 4:3.
